brief.goal: Preserve the user-approved, high-detail bedtime bear model and its coherent phone-to-sleep event as the minimum ZenFlow craft baseline.
nonGoals: Do not treat layer count, shape count, compressed bytes, or tool choice as an artistic quality score.
Do not grant approval to a compact Telegram export or any derivative that the user did not separately view.
Do not claim application, native runtime, public deployment, store, or release parity from the standalone preview.

evidence: Direct user approval in the active Codex conversation after viewing the exact MP4 on an iPhone.
Source manifest identity copied into the critic report and bound to the master SHA-256.
The inspected source audit describes the candidate as an original teddy bear rather than a reproduction of the earlier reference character.
limitations: No standalone license file or independent legal opinion was found in the source visualization workspace.
The 3,270,243-byte master remains outside the repository and is preserved here by exact path, size, and SHA-256.
Approval is evidence- and artifact-bound; it is not a blanket license or approval for future derivatives.

target.codec: gzip-compressed Lottie JSON; review proxy H.264/yuv420p

technicalReceipts.evidence: The source TGS manifest reports valid JSON/gzip output with SHA-256 1d9ec0fe08bbeea17e2a513e54e2abf10054e6ac861f1390ff9c712556508a9a.
Source manifest and fresh ffprobe evidence both report 512 x 512.
Source manifest and fresh ffprobe evidence both report 60 FPS.
Source manifest and fresh ffprobe evidence both report 180 frames.
Source manifest loop gate records frame 0 and frame 179 using foreground_20; the target is a three-second loop.
Quality-master profile records 3,270,243 bytes without a master ceiling; Telegram compact is explicitly separate and unapproved.
Master is gzip-compressed vector Lottie with no raster assets; preview is H.264/yuv420p.
Source technical audit records zero structural violations, zero raster assets, and zero text layers for the master profile.
The master composition and portable evidence are bounded to a 512 x 512 canvas.
The exact MP4 decodes under ffprobe and the complete preview was viewed by the user; cross-engine app runtime remains separately UNVERIFIED.

Technical.evidence: Exact artifact hashes/sizes and MP4 media facts were freshly verified; master structural facts are hash-bound to its source manifest.

Visual Runtime.evidence: The MP4 was viewed on iPhone, but ZenFlow Web/PWA/Capacitor/WKWebView/Tauri and Telegram engine parity were not tested.

Artistic-Craft.evidence: Direct user approval bound to the exact viewed preview SHA-256.

Motion.evidence: Direct user approval covered the complete 180-frame MP4 animation.

Model.evidence: Direct user approval covered the high-detail contact-v8-layered bear model shown in the MP4.

Plan.evidence: The user directly authorized the durable baseline, proof schema, routing, tests, CI integration, and documented rollback.

humanApproval.statement: Превосходно. Я полностью одобряю эту модель и анимацию. Впредь все модели и анимации ZenFlow должны делаться в таком же или более высоком качестве.
humanApproval.reviewedOn: Complete MP4 preview viewed by the user on an iPhone

compactDelivery.reason: The user viewed the master-derived MP4, not a compact Telegram TGS; no compact artifact may inherit this approval.

platformMatrix.evidence: No ZenFlow Vite runtime integration or browser playback was part of the approval evidence.
No installed PWA, offline cache, or asset-update behavior was tested.
No Android WebView emulator or device runtime was tested for this artifact.
The MP4 was viewed on an iPhone, but not inside the ZenFlow WKWebView runtime.
No Tauri renderer or packaged desktop runtime was tested.
The quality master is 3,270,243 bytes and not Telegram-upload-ready; compact technical and artistic parity remain unverified.
No reduced-motion fallback or accessibility runtime was integrated or reviewed.
No app bundle, decode, memory, frame-pacing, or low-end target benchmark was run.
The source manifest reports local vectors without raster/text assets, but no independent provenance/legal or packaged-metadata audit was performed.
A fresh RED-to-GREEN focused validator suite covers missing evidence, false artistic PASS, compact approval inheritance, and changed-asset packet coverage.
The baseline is portable and hash-bound, but the original generation pipeline remains outside this repository.
